title: The Spirit of Sweetwater
summary: "The Spirit of Sweetwater" by Hamlin Garland is a novel written in the late 19th century. As Clement navigates his newfound status and burgeoning feelings for Ellice, he confronts his past decisions and ultimately seeks redemption by returning his ill-gotten wealth to loyal friends who aided him in his rise.
